ios.durability_boundary: URLCache disk storage is managed by iOS system heuristics. Media is not guaranteed to persist across system cache purges, restarts, or memory pressure. No offline bundle of destination photography exists.
ios.offline_behavior: Previously rendered images may display from disk cache; un-cached requests fail gracefully and present non-photo empty-media category fallback treatments.

android.mechanism: Coil AsyncImage backed by OkHttp DiskLruCache
android.durability_boundary: Disk cache is stored in context.cacheDir/image_cache and subject to LRU eviction and Android system storage trimming. No offline master image bundle is embedded.
android.offline_behavior: Cached bitmaps load from disk; un-cached images display non-photo category fallback icons.

truth_calibration.previous_claim_calibrated: Downgraded from durable/guaranteed media availability to SYSTEM_CACHE_BEST_EFFORT on both platforms.
truth_calibration.user_disclosure: Images are cached during online browsing where storage permits, but offline viewing cannot guarantee un-cached photos.
